name: Krasnodar Krai-Serpukhov Gas Pipeline, Leningradskaya-Rostov section (km 83-114)

values.PipelineName: Krasnodar Krai-Serpukhov Gas Pipeline, Leningradskaya-Rostov section (km 83-114)

monitor_reason: sponsor and concrete step: no sponsor named and no step beyond inclusion in the federal territorial-planning scheme (816-r Annex 4 item 345); also unclear whether it is new pipe or a replacement/reconstruction of the existing P1470/P5551 trunk, so no new row is supportable. Length (31 km) is only the km-range difference, not a sourced length.
researcher_notes: Government Order 816-r Annex 4 (sudact.ru, verified by url_verifier, item 345) lists 'Газопровод Краснодарский край - Серпухов на участке Ленинградская - Ростов (83 - 114 км)', Rostov Oblast (Azovsky/Samarskoe; Kagalnitsky/Mokrobataiskoe, Kirovskoe; Aksaisky/Istominskoe, Olginskoe), design transport volume 12.828 bcm/y, purpose: raising reliability of gas supply to Rostov Oblast and Krasnodar Krai. The item is in the annex of main gas pipelines planned for placement and lacks the word 'Реконструкция' used on neighbouring items (e.g. items 17, 39, 120, 382), so new-loop vs replacement is not determinable from the text. The 12.828 bcm/y figure is a whole-line design volume, consistent with a section of the existing Krasnodar Krai-Serpukhov I/II trunk (P1470 1020 mm / P5551 820 mm, 1177 km, both operating), not a stand-alone new pipeline. Four Russian web searches (Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar / Rostov LPUMG, investment programme, section km 83-114) found no sponsor announcement, FEED/EPC award, permit, tender or construction news; no diameter, no cost. Single planning-document source, tier low, route not researched. If a Gazprom Transgaz Krasnodar tender or replacement project surfaces, route to Update on P1470/P5551 (section replacement) rather than a new row (P5686 looping precedent applies only if a parallel new line is evidenced). Not in GGIT snapshot 20260930 under any Leningradskaya/Rostov-section name.
